title: Thai Apple Bisque
description: A refreshing twist on a classic bisque, combining the sweetness of apples with the bold flavors of Thailand.
instructions: In a large pot, sauté the Thai Red Curry Paste in a little bit of oil until fragrant.
Add the chopped apples and cook until they start to soften.
Pour in the Vegetable Broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat and let it simmer for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the mixture until smooth.
Stir in the Light Coconut Milk and Venezuelan Cane Sugar.
Return the pot to the heat and warm the bisque through.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh Cilantro.
